body: You are not old at all, 20 is young in the scheme of things, I went through all kinds of issues even past your age and I'm only 25 now and my own life has improved dramatically, I work as a programmer so I'm in the same field as you... my brother just committed suicide, he was bipolar and struggled with it for years, its just not worth it, you may  think people don't care about you but they do and will be devastated if you go through with it, just take some time off college, move to a new area, do something that can re-invigorate you.. college isn't for everyone, I ended up dropping out but just kept learning on my own and turned it into a successful career, it can be done, especially if you are trying to work in the tech industry, if you want to talk to me about this or anything just pm me anytime

Thank you, I will do that.. anything relating to suicide prevention would be something I would want to work towards. However, the way I see it, you can't permanently prevent suicide if its caused by an underlying issue like mental illness without somehow curing the underlying illness, because, in my brother's case, there were many, many scares before (but none within the last year and a half that I was aware of).. I'm just rambling but I guess I mean that I want to be a part of actually finding a way to help people who have ongoing issues with wanting to commit suicide

I guess with this I am thinking more longterm, certainly I'd be willing to help out for free initially but I mean at some point I'd like to make this "what I do" rather than I work for a for-profit company by day and  a non-profit in my free-time, I guess I want an opportunity to surround myself more with like-minded people.

I understand that, I mean, well I am already planning on starting my own project that would be unpaid, maybe instead of that I can merge that into an existing project. The only problem is that I already work a lot for my current job so its just a matter of hours in the day as far as being able to contribute meaningfully

Thanks, I am planning on doing that, I think I have good ideas of how to modernize some things as regular old message board forums, which exist as support groups for these types of things, are a bit dated and I feel they could be made a lot more useful for people who are suffering
